feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 July 2026 5:09pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 28 July 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low to the northwest of Ireland. High over northern France, transferring eastwards.


##Wind##

Mainly South or Southwest 5 or 6 this evening, although 4 in Liverpool Bay, then decreasing 4 or 5 in all waters early tonight and Southwest 3 or 4 late in night or at first tomorrow morning. Little change thereafter, although veering North or Northwest 3 or 4 in northwest of area late tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, but slight in Liverpool Bay, falling generally slight later tonight and at first tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy rain tomorrow, mainly in far west later in afternoon.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Becoming West or Northwest 3 or 4 in all waters tomorrow evening or at first overnight. West 3 or 4 at first on Thursday, increasing 4 or 5 for a time later in morning and early afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, possibly slight to moderate later.


##Weather##

Patchy rain clearing, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in rain at first.
